reviews.x: These lashes are VERY dramatic. I saw a few negative reviews stating that they were too much but the description and photos give accurate measurements so it was no surprise to me. They’re pretty easy to put on and they came packaged perfectly. SO  Pros Easy to apply Easy to remove Drama without much hassle  Cons Heavy Don’t fit my eyelid quite right and are difficult to trim off excess  TIPS Apply your regular eyeliner first. If you use this eyeliner, it runs a bit and your lashes may not stick

I LOVE THEM! It was my first time ever using magnetic lashes and I was a little skeptical about them. After putting them on im OBSESSED. They took no time at all to apply and they are so comfortable. I highly recommend them

I purchased these in April 2020 and can say that this is a time saver and after about my 3rd try, I think I did  pretty good. It's 5 different styles. reviews.t: Ok, if don't mind cakey feel
reviews.x: Being that I do makeup professionally it is very easy to use. Definitely last longer to use reg lash glue. But if looking to have a faster lash routine that last a few hrs then this is for you.  I repeat, a few hours at max. Very difficult to get lined up perfectly plush to lashes to not give double row of lashes. But it is possible. With the time spent to make look realistic you may as well use lash glue in my opinion.  Would not use eyeliner to replace my regular one due to the cakey feel that

i love the fact that it pops right on !  and it stays on  until you take it off . the cons are the lashes itself dont stand up to wear and tear after 2 applications the lash gets torn or limpy ..i wouldnt take a shower with water hitting your face the glue will hold with the moisture but the curl in the lash will become limp and straight.

I read the reviews before buying and was skeptical because I saw so many bad reviews,but I'm so glad I made the decision to purchase anyway. They were easy to put on and easy to take off. It was also easy to wash off. If you follow the directions on the back of the box you should not have any problems. Was well worth the value.😊

reviews.t: Something in my eye x 3 tries
reviews.x: Maybe I am allergic to iron or magnetic eyeliner, but ooh does this product cause some eye pain. Plus the lash doesn’t stay adhered at the inner corner of the eyelid. It gets painful after an hour or so to wear this kind of lash, for me at least.
The magnetic strip is way long and you can't cut them do to the magnet.. very uncomfortable at least after wearing the 1st pair. The eyeliner cracks-not pretty

I had been seeing Facebook ads for glamnetic lashes on Facebook for months but they are so expensive so I went to Amazon. I figured "If they don't work, oh well. It's only $12." I didn't get around to testing them until the night before my wedding. My maid of honor and I were giggling at how well they were sticking to my hand. MAKE SURE YOU SHAKE THE EYE LINER! Even my MUA was amazed because she has never bought them for her arsenal so she hadn't seen them in action before. They only came off on

I really wanted to like this product.. but I just simply can’t. The only thing I like about it is the concept of how easy it should be. But honestly it isn’t even that. Let’s start with the liner itself.. I hate it. My cap never stays on, so I often get the liner all over my fingers. It’s very cakey so a smooth line is next to impossible. It bleeds into your lashes so easily and it’s mad hard to get out. I’ve ruined many many eye looks trying to use the liner. It says to absolutely not get it in

The lashes are beautiful, but I gave 3 stars because of the liquid eyeliner. The lashes don’t seem to stick for long, especially in corners & when I was in the sun the liner was smudging & making my eyelids black. Application is super easy, takes time to get used to putting the liner on if you aren’t used to doing it, but I would just suggest finding a better magnetic liner. Hope this helps!

reviews.t: Cute lashes but the liner is like trying to put gum to your eyelids....
reviews.x: I really like the lashes but the liner is like gorilla glue texture its awful to apply and turns to gum on the lid. And when adjusting the lashes even slightly it pulls up the liner.. I've let it set for anywhere from five to fifteen minutes and it doesn't change the issue. Horrible.

This was not as I expected! Difficult to use eyeliner it is too thick on eyelid and hard to get lashes to go on right.

I'm not a huge fan of the eyeliner so I actually do my own liner first and use this over top of it just where I would like my lashes to sit. I recommend them to everyone I know. reviews.t: Maybe it's the magnet lash glue
reviews.x: These are beautiful visually, but I followed the directions to the T and the magnet on the lashes still didn't stick. I shook the container for a couple of mins, applied it to my lids 3 times and they wouldn't stick and the glue just lifted from my lids, I even used the cool setting on my blow dryer to make sure they were getting dry and it was useless..  I paid almost $20 for these things and I could have just used the regular glue.  They stuck with my regular lash glue with no problems, magnet

These lashes work great. I would love them if not for the smell. Like, why is the eyeliner so heavily scented?? Seriously...I dont want to be assaulted by the smell of my own eyelids all day. It's so strong, and doesn't quit. I put these on in the morning, and when I went to kiss my daughter goodnight she asked why I smelled funny. No good, man. I gave them 4 stars because they do what they're supposed to with very little effort and look pretty, as long as I hold my breath.

I like How the eye lashes been made but the problem on this product the 3 pair of Eyelashes won’t stick on the magnetic eyeliner even Input 3 coat already it’s so frustrating because i keep trying it for few times to stick but ending I give up. I ending up throwing them in the garbage. I hope this seller refund me for this coz I waste my money on this but if not it’s fine because I won’t purchase it again.

Terrible product. The eyeliner was dry in the container and smelled strongly like perfume. Not a delicate clean scent, but as if your great great aunt Edna had broken a bottle of dime store perfume mixed with PineSol in your eye. The 3 magnets on the lashes are small and spaced far apart, giving space for gapping. I am returning this product and will definitely never buy again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes quick and easy to apply and remove.
Several reviewers praise the lashes for staying on well and lasting through the day.
A common complaint is that the magnetic eyeliner is difficult to work with, cakey, gummy, or smudges and peels.
Some reviewers report discomfort, irritation, or difficulty getting the lashes to adhere at the corners.
A few reviewers note the lashes don't hold up to wear and tear or are too long and can't be trimmed.
